spans.s: अकेतन अ-केतन, अस्, आ, अम्, houseless.

अकेतु अ-केतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. shapeless,
unrecognisable; (Sāy.) unconscious.
अकेश अ-केश, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of hair.

आके आके, ind. (fr. rt. अञ्च् with आ), Ved.
hitherward, near, in the neighbourhood.
—आके-निप,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. considering or regarding from a near
place; wise; (Sāy.) falling down near at hand, ad-
vancing near (as rays of light).
आ-केकर, अस्, ई, अम्, slightly looking askance.
